title: BoatSoundUtils
description: Client-side block tap and boat bump sounds for boats.
body:
Client-side block tap and boat bump sounds for boats. Depending on speed pitch and volume are changed. You can upload custom sounds if you dont like the ones already in the mod. You can edit anything from the ModMenu settings of the mod.

A more complete version of BoatSoundUtils is coming soon, featuring more actions in addition to the block tap and boat bump
